source: NCERT Class VII, Our Environment, Geography Ch. 4.

sections.heading: 1. The Atmosphere
points: The **atmosphere** = the blanket of air surrounding the Earth, held by **gravity**; it protects us and makes life possible.
**Composition:** **Nitrogen ~78%, Oxygen ~21%**, and ~1% others (**carbon dioxide, argon**, water vapour, dust).
**Oxygen** = for breathing/burning; **carbon dioxide** = for photosynthesis and traps heat; **nitrogen** = for plant growth.

sections.heading: 2. Layers of the Atmosphere (bottom → top)
points: **Troposphere** — lowest layer; **all weather** occurs here; we breathe here.
**Stratosphere** — above it; contains the **ozone layer** (absorbs harmful UV rays); calm, so **aeroplanes fly** here.
**Mesosphere** — meteors burn up here.
**Thermosphere** — very hot; **ionosphere** here reflects radio waves.
**Exosphere** — outermost, thin layer merging into space.

sections.heading: 3. Weather, Climate and Temperature
points: **Weather** = the atmosphere's condition at a place over a **short time** (day to day).
**Climate** = the **average weather** over a **long period** (many years).
**Temperature** decreases from the **equator to the poles** and with **altitude**; measured by a **thermometer**.

sections.heading: 4. Air Pressure, Winds and Moisture
points: **Air pressure** = the weight of air; it is **higher at sea level**, lower at height; measured by a **barometer**.
**Wind** = moving air; it blows from **high pressure to low pressure**.
**Moisture:** water vapour → clouds → **precipitation (rain, snow, hail)**; rainfall measured by a **rain gauge**.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Air ≈ 78% nitrogen, 21% oxygen; held by gravity.
Layers: Troposphere (weather) → Stratosphere (ozone; planes) → Mesosphere (meteors) → Thermosphere (ionosphere/radio) → Exosphere.
Weather = short-term; climate = long-term average.
Air pressure: barometer; wind blows high→low pressure; rainfall: rain gauge.
Winds: permanent (trade), seasonal (monsoon), local (land/sea breeze, loo).

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: **Weather occurs in the troposphere**; the **ozone layer** is in the **stratosphere**.
Wind always blows from **high to low pressure**.
**Weather** = short-term condition; **climate** = long-term average — don't confuse.
Nitrogen (78%) is the **most abundant** atmospheric gas, not oxygen.
